profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage. The company says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades and makes storage that scales. Its website states that the company brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The company's site discusses AI's effect on data growth and storage requirements. It says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, and that Seagate is optimizing storage for AI, making capacity advances to support data center architecture and buildout. The site also mentions five strategic shifts intended to close the gap between AI's data demands and infrastructure readiness.

Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker STX, headquartered in Singapore, with SEC CIK 0001137789. No litigation or MCP servers are listed in the available facts, and no products are listed.
